Good to know Scheduling notes

For overnight shifts, choose the following date for the end time. Eastern daylight saving changes are included in elapsed hours.

A split can be used as a lunch. Existing policy guidance: schedule US and MX lunches before five hours; lunch is unpaid in US and MX.

Existing California guidance: daily limit of 11 hours when overtime is available; eight hours on the seventh day.
